player.title: Player Server Discovery Survey
player.description: Help us build a better way to find Hytale servers. Takes ~4 minutes.

thankYou.title: Thanks for helping us build a better way to find Hytale servers!
thankYou.description: Follow @pixelkoh for updates. Leave your Discord username to join our beta testers.

screenOut.title: Thanks for your interest!
screenOut.description: This survey is for players who have tried Hytale multiplayer. Check back once you've played!

discovery.title: Finding Servers
discovery.description: How do you find servers today?

what_matters.title: What Matters
what_matters.description: What do you look for in a server?

feature_prioritization.title: Features
feature_prioritization.description: Which features would you actually use?

q1.title: How long have you been playing Hytale multiplayer?

q2.title: How many different Hytale servers have you tried?

q3.title: What game mode do you primarily play?
q3.subtitle: Pick the one you play most

q4.title: How did you find the server(s) you play on?
q4.subtitle: Select up to 3

q5.title: How satisfied are you with how easy it is to find good Hytale servers?

q6.title: What is the SINGLE biggest frustration when looking for a server?
q6.subtitle: Pick the one that bothers you most

options.too_many_options: Too many options, hard to know which is good
options.cant_tell_active: Can't tell if a server is active or dead
options.cant_find_playstyle: Can't find servers for my playstyle
options.same_servers_top: Same servers always at the top of lists
options.no_reviews: No reviews or reliable info about the server before joining
options.listings_outdated: Server listings feel outdated or abandoned
options.too_laggy: Server is too laggy after joining
options.dont_know_anyone: Don't know anyone on the server

q7.title: When choosing a server, pick your TOP 3 most important factors:
q7.subtitle: Select exactly 3

options.active_players: Active player count (people are actually online)
options.close_region: Server region close to me (low ping)

q8.title: Of your top 3, which one would make you LEAVE a server if it was bad?
q8.subtitle: Pick the dealbreaker

q9.title: How often do you switch servers?

options.multiple_regularly: I play on multiple servers regularly
options.havent_found: I haven't found a server I like yet

q10.title: Information before joining
q10.subtitle: Which is MOST important and LEAST important to you?

options.text_reviews: Read player reviews with specific ratings (community, performance, fairness)
options.video_review: Watch a video review showing actual gameplay on the server
options.realtime_count: See real-time player count and peak hours

q11.title: How servers should surface to you
q11.subtitle: Which is MOST important and LEAST important to you?

options.server_of_day: Rotating "Server of the Day" spotlights (not always the same servers on top)
options.difficulty_filter: Filter servers by difficulty level (beginner-friendly vs. expert)
options.lfg_board: "Looking for Group" board to find teammates
options.friends_play: See what servers your friends play on

q12.title: Trust & quality signals
q12.subtitle: Which is MOST important and LEAST important to you?

options.reviewer_hours: Reviews show how many hours the reviewer played on that server
options.owner_responds: Server owner can respond to reviews
options.retention_rate: See a server's player retention rate (do people keep coming back?)
options.actively_updated: The server is actively updated with new content or events

q13.title: How likely are you to write a review for a server you've played on?

options.very_likely: Very likely — I like sharing my experience
options.strong_experience: Only if I had a strong experience (really great or really bad)
options.unlikely: Unlikely — I'd read reviews but not write them
options.not_interested: Not interested in reviews at all

q14.title: What makes a server review trustworthy?
q14.subtitle: Pick top 2

options.hours_played: Shows how many hours the reviewer played on that server
options.specific_aspects: Rates specific aspects separately (community, performance, fairness)
options.screenshots_video: Includes screenshots or video of actual gameplay
options.recent_review: The review is recent (less than 2 weeks old)
options.helpful_votes: Other players voted the review as "helpful"
options.sentiment_summary: An overall sentiment summary like "Mostly Positive" or "Mixed"
options.username_visible: The reviewer's username and playtime are visible (not anonymous)

q15.title: What review format would be most useful for evaluating a server?

options.binary_steam: Simple "Recommend / Don't Recommend" with a text comment (Steam style)
options.stars_amazon: 1–5 star rating with a text comment (Amazon/Google style)
options.multi_criteria: Rate specific aspects separately — community, performance, content, fairness
options.just_label: Just show me an overall label like "Mostly Positive" — I don't read individual reviews

q16.title: After you hear about a server, what do you do before joining?
q16.subtitle: Pick top 2

options.just_join: Just join it and see for myself
options.check_listing: Check the server's listing page (player count, description, reviews)
options.join_discord: Join their Discord to get a feel for the community
options.youtube_twitch: Look for YouTube/Twitch content about the server
options.ask_friends: Ask friends or other players about it
options.mobile_browse: Browse server listing sites on my phone, then join from PC later
options.save_bookmark: Save/bookmark it to try later when I have time
options.follow_updates: Follow the server to get notified about updates or events

q17.title: What language do you prefer for gaming content?
